title: CMS
for: the website and blog CMS: publishing approved content, reading what is live

manual.export: paste the draft into the CMS by hand; the agent only sets published_url in the repo

vendors.name: Webflow
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__webflow`) until checked
publishing a site or CMS item is a live, user-visible write: humans decide (AGENTS.md rule 3)
in the Claude connectors directory; the repo `webflow/mcp-server` is read on the vendor page, the endpoint is from a secondary listing (an `/sse` endpoint also exists)

vendors.name: Contentful
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__contentful`) until checked
the local server also reads a space id and environment id from its environment; the exact variable names are in the package README at the pinned version, confirm them before wiring
publishing an entry is a live write: humans decide

auth.where: Contentful > Settings > CMA tokens (a personal or a space-scoped Content Management API token)

vendors.name: Sanity
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__sanity`) until checked
remote only: the local `@sanity/mcp-server` package is deprecated and its repo archived; do not wire it
the host is confirmed; check on the day you wire it whether the path is `/` or `/mcp` (the vendor docs page moved and returned 404 today)

vendors.name: WordPress
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__wordpress`) until checked

two parts: the `WordPress/mcp-adapter` plugin installed on the site (the successor of `Automattic/wordpress-mcp`, archived 2025-08) exposes the server, and the `@automattic/mcp-wordpress-remote` npm proxy connects a stdio client to it; both are needed
the proxy reads the site URL and an application password (or a JWT) from its environment; the exact variable names are in the proxy's README at the pinned version, confirm them before wiring
the mcp-adapter plugin is young; verify its maturity and that it is active on the site
publishing a post is a live write: humans decide
WordPress.org also runs a docs-only MCP for plugin developers; it is not a site server

auth.where: WordPress admin > Users > Profile > Application Passwords, on the site running the mcp-adapter plugin

vendors.name: Storyblok
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__storyblok`) until checked
hosted on Storyblok Labs (innovation phase); the open-source `storyblok/mcp-server` repo is archived
auth is a management token; the header format is assumed as a bearer token and must be confirmed on the Labs page before wiring

auth.where: Storyblok > My account > Personal access tokens (a management API token)

vendors.name: Hygraph
caveats: Early Access
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__hygraph`) until checked
delete and unpublish are not available over MCP by design; a permanent auth token's permissions decide read, create, update and publish
the global endpoint signs in with the Hygraph account; project-scoped endpoints take a permanent auth token; the token header format is not on the docs page, confirm before wiring

auth.where: Hygraph project > Settings > Permanent Auth Tokens (an MCP Server token)

vendors.name: Ghost
caveats: no official server
community server maintained by MFYDev (`MFYDev/ghost-mcp`, Admin API key, read and write on posts and members); judge as a script, not a vendor tool
use the manual route or a script against the Admin API

vendors.name: Framer
caveats: no official server; only a third-party marketplace plugin
use the manual route
